scope: Test whether the documented SA control's persistent 2500-iteration lateral and moment mode is caused by insufficient SIMPLE under-relaxation.

single_change.name: uniform_half_scale_SIMPLE_under_relaxation
single_change.selection_rule: Apply one factor of 0.5 to every under-relaxation value inherited from the packaged upstream tutorial; do not tune fields independently.
single_change.initialization: Copy the fully reconstructed cumulative-10000 U, p, nuTilda, and nut fields to time zero on the identical mesh with SHA-256 provenance.

fixed.model: stock OpenFOAM v2512 SpalartAllmaras, default SA-noft2 form
fixed.schemes: documented linearUpwind velocity and nuTilda convection

falsifiable_expectation.primary: The final and last-100 maximum Uy initial residual and projected 500-iteration Cl/Cm changes fall below the existing Gate 1 thresholds.
falsifiable_expectation.secondary: The 2500-iteration Cl/Cm oscillation amplitude decreases relative to the undamped continuation.
falsifiable_expectation.drag: No target direction is assumed. CFL3D drag agreement is evaluated only after iterative and symmetry gates pass.

terminal_rule: If damping does not pass the existing iterative and symmetry gates, do not extend or retune it. Next run must isolate serial/decomposition behavior. If damping converges, evaluate unchanged force agreement; if drag still fails, proceed to Cp/Cf localization and then separate nuTilda/nu=4-to-3 from SA-noft2-to-standard-SA tests.
